name: AI Chatbot, Live Chat & Lead Generation for WordPress
author: robofyaichatbot

sections.description:
Robofy helps you add an AI chatbot / Agent to your WordPress site without coding.

Instead of using a fixed script or FAQ tree, Robofy learns from your actual website content and answers visitor questions in a natural, helpful way. It can read your pages, posts, WooCommerce products, and additional content sources so your chatbot stays relevant to your business.

Whether you want to answer common questions, reduce support load, guide shoppers, or capture leads, Robofy gives you a simple way to do it directly from WordPress.

Why site owners like Robofy

  • Easy setup from your WordPress admin
  • No coding or API key setup required
  • Train the chatbot on your own website content
  • Answer visitor questions automatically, 24/7
  • Capture leads and send them to your team
  • Review chats and improve responses over time
  • Works for business websites, service sites, blogs, and WooCommerce stores

Main features

  • Train on WordPress pages and posts
  • Train on WooCommerce products, including product details and FAQs
  • Crawl website URLs to build your chatbot knowledge base
  • Upload extra content such as PDFs, documents, and FAQs
  • Customise chatbot colours, greeting, logo, and position
  • View conversation history from your chat inbox
  • See analytics such as message volume and unanswered questions
  • Automatic re-crawling to keep chatbot knowledge updated
  • Supports 50+ languages
  • Lead capture during chat conversations
  • WhatsApp support through Robofy plans

Good fit for

  • medium and large business websites
  • WooCommerce stores
  • Agencies building sites for clients
  • Service businesses handling repeated questions
  • Teams that want a simple AI assistant on their website

External Services

This plugin communicates with the Robofy backend API to provide AI chatbot functionality.

  • Privacy policy: https://www.robofy.ai/privacy-policy
  • Terms of service: https://www.robofy.ai/terms-of-service

By using this plugin you agree to Robofy’s terms of service and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Navigate to “AI Chatbot” in your admin sidebar
  4. Log in or create a Robofy account
  5. Create your first agent and embed it on your site
sections.faq:
Do I need coding skills to use this plugin?

No. Robofy is designed for WordPress users who want to launch a chatbot without writing code.

What content can the chatbot learn from?

Robofy can learn from WordPress pages, blog posts, WooCommerce products, crawled URLs, and uploaded content such as PDFs or other documents.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Robofy can train on your WooCommerce product content so visitors can ask questions about products, pricing, features, and related information.

Can I customise the chatbot design?

Yes. You can adjust the chatbot’s look and feel, including colours, greeting message, logo, and placement, to better match your brand.

Can the chatbot capture leads?

Yes. Robofy can collect visitor details during chat and help qualify leads before sending them to your team.

Can I see past conversations?

Yes. The plugin includes access to a chat inbox where you can review conversation history.

Does the chatbot support multiple languages?

Yes. Robofy supports 50+ languages, helping you serve a wider audience.

Will the chatbot stay updated when my website content changes?

Yes. Robofy supports re-crawling so your chatbot can stay aligned with updated site content.

Can I connect Robofy with other tools?

Yes. Depending on your Robofy plan, you can use integrations such as webhooks, APIs, and Zapier to send data to other systems.

Do I need a Robofy account?

Yes. A Robofy account is required to create, train, and manage your chatbot.
